description: This file defines a custom Swing JLabel subclass 'URLLabel' that displays clickable URLs within a Java GUI. It provides methods to create URL labels with proper URI handling, visual styling with underlined text, and functionality to open the links in the system's default browser when clicked.

classes.name: URLLabel
classes.description: A Swing JLabel that displays a clickable hyperlink which opens in the default web browser when clicked. Supports setting the URL via String or URI, visual feedback on mouse hover, and proper URI handling with fallback.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with the given text and URI.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with the given text and URL string, converting the string to URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Static method to safely create a URI from a string, throwing RuntimeException on invalid syntax.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the label's appearance and behavior, including setting cursor, tooltip, and mouse listeners.

methods.name: addUrlAction
methods.description: Adds a mouse click listener to open the URL when the label is clicked.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Overrides JLabel's setText to support underlined styling based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Static method to open the URL in the system's default web browser, with error handling and user notifications.
